modules.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
modules.description: This module introduces the basics of Artificial Intelligence, including its history, types, and applications.

sub_modules.title: History of Artificial Intelligence
sub_modules.description: This submodule covers the evolution of AI, from its inception to the present day.

activities.title: Reading and Summarizing AI History Articles
activities.description: Read a list of articles about the history of AI and summarize their main points.

activities.title: Discussing AI History with Peers
activities.description: Engage in a group discussion to share perspectives on the evolution of AI.

quiz.question1: What is considered the birth year of AI?

activities.title: Types of Artificial Intelligence
activities.description: This submodule explores the main types of AI, including narrow or weak AI and general or strong AI.

activities.id: Activity1.2.1: Watch a video on Narrow vs General AI
activities.title: Watching a Video on Narrow vs General AI
activities.description: Watch a short video that explains the differences between narrow and general AI.

quiz.question2: What is the main difference between narrow and general AI?
quiz.answer2: Narrow AI focuses on one task, while general AI can perform multiple tasks

activities.title: Applications of Artificial Intelligence
activities.description: This submodule covers various applications of AI in different fields.

activities.id: Activity1.3.1: Research and list AI applications
activities.title: Researching and Listing AI Applications
activities.description: Research the current applications of AI in several fields, such as healthcare or finance.

quiz.question3: What is an example of AI's application in medicine?
quiz.answer3: Image recognition to aid medical diagnosis

activities.id: Submodule1.4: Ethics and Bias in AI
activities.title: Ethics and Bias in Artificial Intelligence
activities.description: This submodule explores the importance of considering ethics and bias when developing AI systems.

activities.id: Activity1.4.1: Watch a video on AI bias
activities.title: Watching a Video on AI Bias
activities.description: Watch a short video that explains how AI can perpetuate biases and stereotypes.

quiz.question4: What is one way AI systems can exhibit bias?
quiz.answer4: Through the data they are trained on

activities.title: Conclusion to Module 1
activities.description: This submodule wraps up module one's topics and encourages learners to continue learning about AI.

activities.id: Activity1.5.1: Reflect on what was learned in the first module
activities.title: Reflecting on Module 1 Content
activities.description: Write down a few key takeaways and insights from learning about AI's history, types, applications, ethics, and more.

quiz.question5: What was the main takeaway from this module?

activities.title: Assignment for Module 1
activities.description: This submodule assigns a few tasks to learners, such as writing an essay on AI history or creating a mind map of AI types.

activities.id: Activity1.6.1: Write an essay on the impact of AI on society
activities.title: Writing an Essay on AI's Impact on Society
activities.description: Write a well-structured, 3-4 page essay on how AI is changing the world.

quiz.question6: What are some potential drawbacks of relying too heavily on AI?
quiz.answer6: Increased job loss and decreased human interaction

activities.title: Peer Review for Module 1 Assignments
activities.description: This submodule provides a mechanism for learners to review and provide feedback on each other's work.

activities.id: Activity1.7.1: Review written assignments of peers
activities.title: Reviewing Peer Written Assignments
activities.description: Read through the essays submitted by peers, providing constructive feedback to improve their work.

quiz.question7: What is the main point you want to convey in your feedback?
quiz.answer7: Helping them improve and refine their writing.

activities.title: Reviewing Peer Feedback on Your Work
activities.description: Read through the feedback given to your written assignment, identifying areas for improvement and considering how to implement those suggestions in future assignments.

quiz.question8: What is one way to ensure you are making progress in improving your writing?
quiz.answer8: Regularly receiving and acting on peer feedback.

activities.title: Quizzes for Module 1
activities.description: This submodule contains a few quizzes to test the learner's understanding of AI concepts.

activities.title: Quiz 1: AI History
activities.description: Take this quiz to assess your knowledge of AI history.
